additional_info.subject: 0393704 - ID0393704-DC/Si-D/SG-[MP / R3 170001682] Router 2 fail to reach after OCPP close CRM:00439000715
additional_info.body:
Hello Edna,
on the timeframe that you are mentioning in the email, something went wrong on the chargers connection both Router1 and Router2  were OFF and AWS connection was also down. On this time something was maybe wrong with the provider or this location.
Anyways i changed some settings on the router 1+2 and did some tests. Now the router should connect much faster to the Backend. as you can see here:

looks like the connection got better and doesnt take so much time to reconnect.
However is it intentionall that the connection gets a reset at UTC (GMT) 8:00 and Singapore Time 16:00 ? It was same for last 3 days.
